visual_action: A montage of video clips shows Speaker Mike Johnson walking through indoor hallways, including past a red 'EXIT' sign, and in a tight close-up. It also shows Donald Trump in a suit and red tie walking on an outdoor red carpet.

cast.name: Mike Johnson
cast.evidence: His face is shown in multiple clips, and he is named in the on-screen text: 'trump and mike johnson...'

cast.name: Donald Trump
cast.evidence: He is shown walking on a red carpet, and he is named in the on-screen text and the post's caption: 'trump and mike johnson...' and 'trump’s first term'.

on_screen_text.text: trump and mike johnson on their way to take zero responsibility for the longest govt shutdown in history

spoken_summary: The only audio is from the background music, with the repeated lyrics "Wiggly wobbly wiggly wobbly wiggly."
audio_music: The video is set to the upbeat rap song 'SHYNE' by Travis Scott & GloRilla. The track plays continuously throughout, creating a swaggering or mocking tone when paired with the visuals of the politicians.
editing_pacing: A fast-paced montage with quick cuts between different clips of the two subjects.
cultural_references: The song 'SHYNE' by Travis Scott and GloRilla is used as the soundtrack.
central_claim: Donald Trump and Mike Johnson are irresponsibly leading the country toward the longest government shutdown in history and are taking no responsibility for it.
intended_effect: To make the viewer see Donald Trump and Mike Johnson as irresponsible and arrogant, and to blame them for an impending government shutdown.
